case_number: Civil Appeal No. 1339 of 2022 [@ SLP(C) No. 22667 of 2019]
summary: Appeal challenging dismissal of divorce petition filed by husband on grounds of cruelty and desertion under Section 13(1)(ia) and (ib) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Marriage solemnized June 17, 2009; wife left matrimonial home June 30, 2009. Husband alleged non-consummation causing mental cruelty and desertion. Both lower courts dismissed petition. Supreme Court found desertion established due to continuous separation exceeding two years, absence of intent to resume cohabitation, and lack of reasonable cause for separation. Rejected cruelty claim but exercised Article 142 powers to dissolve marriage due to irretrievable breakdown, directing husband to pay Rs. 15 lakhs to wife.
legal_provisions_cited: Lachman Utamchand Kirpalani v. Meena @ Mota
final_judgment: Impugned judgments set aside; marriage dissolved by decree of divorce under Section 13(1)(ib) of Hindu Marriage Act; appellant directed to pay Rs. 15,00,000/- (fifteen lakhs) to respondent within 8 weeks.
